narration_timeline.text: Why does a common blackbird keep returning to the same park paths?
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird visible in city park habitat.

narration_timeline.text: It explores short grass and the edges of paths, pausing to inspect the ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird on park lawn or path.

narration_timeline.text: In a botanical garden, even small patches of soil and leaves can attract a searching bird.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbirds in two distinct botanical garden scenes.

narration_timeline.text: A few quick steps take it from open ground toward bushes, where it can disappear from view.
narration_timeline.scene: Two blackbird scenes in park vegetation.

narration_timeline.text: A blackbird's rounded body and alert head turns make its movements easy to follow.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird visibly turning or pausing in a park.

narration_timeline.text: Then it is off again, checking another patch of the park for its next bite.
narration_timeline.scene: Blackbird moving through another park patch.
